objective.reconstruction: For e>=0, F(e|X)=1-p_plus+p_plus*F_plus(e|X). If alpha<=1-p_plus margin=0; else u=(alpha-1+p_plus)/p_plus and invert conditional CDF. u<=alpha<=.95. Conditional quantile knots monotonic repaired with Q_plus(0)=0; piecewise-linear inverse. Negative residual mass conservatively placed at zero.
objective.stage1: binary:logistic on all OOF rows, event residual>0, 300 rounds
objective.stage2: reg:quantileerror on strictly positive OOF excess/3600, 250 rounds
